literal: Shizong, Emperor Xuanwu, bore the taboo name Ke; he was Gaozu, Emperor Xiaowen's second son.
idiomatic: Shizong, Emperor Xuanwu, bore the taboo name Ke. He was Gaozu, Emperor Xiaowen's second son.

literal: His mother was Lady Gao. At first she dreamed the sun pursued her; she hid under the bed, and the sun turned into a dragon that coiled around her several times. She awoke in shock, and afterward conceived.
idiomatic: His mother was Lady Gao. At first she dreamed the sun pursued her; she hid under the bed, and the sun turned into a dragon that coiled around her several times. She awoke in shock, and afterward conceived.

literal: In the intercalary fourth month of the seventh year of Taihe, the Emperor was born in the Pingcheng palace.
idiomatic: In the intercalary fourth month of the seventh year of Taihe, the emperor was born in the Pingcheng palace.

literal: In the twenty-first year, first month, day jiawu, he was installed as crown prince.
idiomatic: In the twenty-first year, in the first month, on the jiawu day, he was installed as crown prince.

literal: In the twenty-third year, fourth month of summer, day dingsi, he took the throne at Luoyang and proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm.
idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, in the fourth month of summer, on the dingsi day, he took the throne at Luoyang and proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm.

literal: The Emperor remained in mourning seclusion and entrusted government to chief ministers.
idiomatic: The emperor remained in mourning seclusion and entrusted government to chief ministers.

literal: Fifth month, day bingzi, new moon: Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the bingzi day, the new moon, Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Sixth month, day yimao: attendant officials were dispatched separately to tour provinces and commanderies, inquire into the people's hardships, examine prefects and magistrates, promote the worthy and demote the unworthy; all civil and military men who answered the call and whose conduct was outstanding in reclusion were given enhanced honors.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the yimao day, attendant officials were dispatched separately to tour provinces and commanderies, inquire into the people's hardships, and examine prefects and magistrates, promoting the worthy and demoting the unworthy; all civil and military men who answered the call and whose conduct was outstanding in reclusion were given enhanced honors.

literal: Day wuchen: the deceased empress mother was posthumously honored as Empress Wenzhao.
idiomatic: On the wuchen day the deceased empress mother was posthumously honored as Empress Wenzhao.

literal: Eighth month of autumn, day wushen: following the testamentary edict, all three consorts of Gaozu and below were sent home.
idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on the wushen day, following the testamentary edict, all three consorts of Gaozu and below were sent home.

literal: Day guichou: palace officials were promoted one rank.
idiomatic: On the guichou day palace officials were promoted one rank.

literal: Day guihai: Military Inspector of South Xuzhou Shen Ling defected south.
idiomatic: On the guihai day Shen Ling, military inspector of South Xuzhou, defected south.

literal: Tenth month of winter, day xinwei: the king of Dengzhi, Xiang Shupeng, came to court.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the xinwei day, Xiang Shupeng, king of Dengzhi, came to court.

literal: Day bingxu: the imperial carriage visited Changling.
idiomatic: On the bingxu day the imperial carriage visited Changling.

literal: Day dingyou: sacrifice at the Grand Temple.
idiomatic: On the dingyou day sacrifice was performed at the Grand Temple.

literal: Eleventh month: the people of Youzhou, Wang Huiding, gathered a crowd and rebelled, styled himself Emperor Mingfa; Inspector Li Su captured and beheaded him.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month the people of Youzhou, Wang Huiding, gathered a crowd and rebelled, styling himself Emperor Mingfa; Inspector Li Su captured and beheaded him.

literal: Fourth month of summer, day bingshen: Prince of Pengcheng Xie and General of Chariots and Cavalry Wang Su greatly defeated them and took heads in the tens of thousands.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the bingshen day, Xie, Prince of Pengcheng, and Wang Su, general of chariots and cavalry, greatly defeated them and took heads in the tens of thousands.

literal: Day jihai: the emperor's younger brother Tiao died.
idiomatic: On the jihai day the emperor's younger brother Tiao died.

literal: Fifth month, day jiayin: because of great famine in the northern garrisons, Acting Palace Attendant Yang Bo was sent to tour, comfort, and relieve.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the jiayin day, because of great famine in the northern garrisons, Yang Bo, acting palace attendant, was sent to tour, comfort, and relieve.

literal: Sixth month, day bingzi: Minister over the Masses, Prince of Pengcheng Xie was advanced to Grand Marshal; General of Chariots and Cavalry Wang Su was given open office and equipage equal to the Three Directors.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the bingzi day, Xie, minister over the masses and Prince of Pengcheng, was advanced to grand marshal; Wang Su, general of chariots and cavalry, was given open office and equipage equal to the Three Directors.

literal: Day guiwei: the Di chieftain of Dayang, Tian Yuqiu, and others led their households inward in submission.
idiomatic: On the guiwei day Tian Yuqiu, Di chieftain of Dayang, and others led their households inward in submission.

literal: Seventh month of autumn: Bao Juan again sent Chen Bozhi to raid Huainan.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn Bao Juan again sent Chen Bozhi to raid Huainan.

literal: Day gengzi: Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the gengzi day Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Eighth month, day yiyou: Prince of Pengcheng Xie defeated Bozhi at Feikou.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the yiyou day, Xie, Prince of Pengcheng, defeated Bozhi at Feikou.

literal: Day yiwei: Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the yiwei day Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Ninth month, day yichou: Inspector of East Yuzhou Tian Yizong defeated Bao Juan's generals Wu Ziyang and Deng Yuanqi at Changfeng.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the yichou day, Tian Yizong, inspector of East Yuzhou, defeated Bao Juan's generals Wu Ziyang and Deng Yuanqi at Changfeng.

literal: The people of Qizhou, Liu Shiming, gathered a crowd and rebelled.
idiomatic: The people of Qizhou, Liu Shiming, gathered a crowd and rebelled.

literal: That year seventeen provinces suffered great famine; envoys were dispatched separately to open granaries for relief.
idiomatic: That year seventeen provinces suffered great famine; envoys were dispatched separately to open granaries for relief.

literal: That winter the island barbarian Xiao Yan raised troops eastward and attacked his lord Bao Juan.
idiomatic: That winter the island barbarian Xiao Yan raised troops eastward and attacked his lord Bao Juan.

literal: Second year, spring, first month, day bingshen, new moon: the imperial carriage visited Changling.
idiomatic: In the second year, in the first month of spring, on the bingshen day, the new moon, the imperial carriage visited Changling.

literal: Day gengxu: the emperor began to govern in person.
idiomatic: On the gengxu day the emperor began to govern in person.

literal: Following the testamentary edict, Prince of Pengcheng Xie, Minister over the Masses, was permitted to return to his estate as a prince.
idiomatic: Following the testamentary edict, Xie, Prince of Pengcheng and minister over the masses, was permitted to return to his estate as a prince.

literal: Grand Commandant, Prince of Xianyang Xi was advanced to Grand Mentor; Minister of Works, Prince of Beihai Xiang was made Grand General and Recorder of the Affairs of the Masters of Writing.
idiomatic: Xi, grand commandant and Prince of Xianyang, was advanced to grand mentor; Xiang, minister of works and Prince of Beihai, was made grand general and recorder of the affairs of the Masters of Writing.

literal: Day dingsi: he received the assembled ministers at the Hall before the Grand Ultimate and announced his intention to oversee government.
idiomatic: On the dingsi day he received the assembled ministers at the Hall before the Grand Ultimate and announced his intention to oversee government.

literal: Day xinyou: Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the xinyou day Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Day renxu: Grand Mentor, Prince of Xianyang Xi was made to hold additionally the post of Grand Commandant; Grand General, Prince of Guangling Yu was made Minister over the Masses.
idiomatic: On the renxu day Xi, grand mentor and Prince of Xianyang, was made to hold additionally the post of grand commandant; Yu, grand general and Prince of Guangling, was made minister over the masses.

literal: [2] An edict said: "We in youth received the imperial succession; sorrow and affliction weigh upon us; we have not personally handled affairs, and customs are not yet harmonized.
idiomatic: [2] An edict said, "We in youth received the imperial succession; sorrow and affliction weigh upon us; we have not personally handled affairs, and customs are not yet harmonized.

literal: Now we first take up government; righteousness calls for renewal; we wish to make the four quarters follow and universally do good—imperial envoys may be dispatched separately to promote the worthy and demote the unworthy.
idiomatic: Now we first take up government; righteousness calls for renewal; we wish to make the four quarters follow and universally do good—imperial envoys may be dispatched separately to promote the worthy and demote the unworthy.

literal: " Second month, day gengwu: guards of the inner palace were promoted one rank.
idiomatic: " In the second month, on the gengwu day, guards of the inner palace were promoted one rank.

literal: Day jiaxu: general amnesty throughout the realm.
idiomatic: On the jiaxu day a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

literal: Third month, day yiwei, new moon: an edict said: "In recent years campaigns have followed one after another; corvée labor has been many, and the hundred surnames are worn down.
idiomatic: In the third month, on the yiwei day, the new moon, an edict said, "In recent years campaigns have followed one after another; corvée labor has been many, and the hundred surnames are worn down.

literal: The season calls for measured compassion to rescue the people's suffering.
idiomatic: The season calls for measured compassion to rescue the people's suffering.

literal: Beyond the regular tax levies, all temporary impositions that harm and injure the people are to be waived at once.
idiomatic: Beyond the regular tax levies, all temporary impositions that harm and injure the people are to be waived at once.

literal: " [3] Day xinhai: an edict said: "Provincial inspectors do not personally attend to the people's affairs; they are slack in supervision; prefectures and counties accumulate arrears—in the space of ten days they barely examine and decide a case.
idiomatic: " [3] On the xinhai day an edict said, "Provincial inspectors do not personally attend to the people's affairs; they are slack in supervision; prefectures and counties accumulate arrears—in the space of ten days they barely examine and decide a case.

literal: Prolonged imprisonment and long litigation constantly delay the seasons; the hundred surnames groan in complaint and are being reduced to distress.
idiomatic: Prolonged imprisonment and long litigation constantly delay the seasons; the hundred surnames groan in complaint and are being reduced to distress.

literal: The Masters of Writing shall set forth regulations clearly and send them down to the four quarters, ordering daily personal attention to common affairs and strict constraint on prefects and magistrates—they may not follow old habits or be lax and negligent, damaging government.
idiomatic: The Masters of Writing shall set forth regulations clearly and send them down to the four quarters, ordering daily personal attention to common affairs and strict constraint on prefects and magistrates—they may not follow old habits or be lax and negligent, damaging government.

literal: " Day renxu: an edict said: "Government values simplicity and stillness; appointment values responding to affairs.
idiomatic: " On the renxu day an edict said, "Government values simplicity and stillness; appointment values responding to affairs.

literal: Provincial and prefectural subordinates and clerks—in appointments to office there are somewhat many, which becomes harm and distress and is of no benefit to the path of government.
idiomatic: Provincial and prefectural subordinates and clerks—in appointments to office there are somewhat many, which becomes harm and distress and is of no benefit to the path of government.

literal: Moreover in the capital the hundred offices have crowded departments; where officials have idle supernumeraries, they follow this precedent as well.
idiomatic: Moreover in the capital the hundred offices have crowded departments; where officials have idle supernumeraries, they follow this precedent as well.

literal: If they do not match what is essential, all are to be reduced and cut.
idiomatic: If they do not match what is essential, all are to be reduced and cut.

literal: " Qing, Qi, Xu, and Yan provinces suffered great famine; more than ten thousand mouths of the people died.
idiomatic: " Qing, Qi, Xu, and Yan provinces suffered great famine; more than ten thousand mouths of the people died.

literal: That month Xiao Yan installed Bao Juan's younger brother, Prince of Nankang Bao Rong, as ruler; era name Zhongxing; he marched east toward Jiankang.
idiomatic: That month Xiao Yan installed Bao Juan's younger brother, Bao Rong, Prince of Nankang, as ruler, with era name Zhongxing, and marched east toward Jiankang.

literal: Fifth month of summer, day renzi: Prince of Guangling Yu died.
idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on the renzi day, Yu, Prince of Guangling, died.

literal: Day renxu: Grand Mentor Prince of Xianyang Xi plotted rebellion and was granted death.
idiomatic: On the renxu day Xi, grand mentor and Prince of Xianyang, plotted rebellion and was granted death.

literal: Sixth month, day dinghai: provincial inspectors were examined and promoted or demoted accordingly.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the dinghai day, provincial inspectors were examined and promoted or demoted accordingly.

literal: Seventh month of autumn, day yisi: the Rouran raided the frontier passes.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the yisi day, the Rouran raided the frontier passes.

literal: Day yiwei: Inspector of East Yuzhou Tian Yizong defeated Bao Juan's general Huang Tiansi at Chiting.
idiomatic: On the yiwei day Tian Yizong, inspector of East Yuzhou, defeated Bao Juan's general Huang Tiansi at Chiting.

literal: Day xinyou: general amnesty throughout the realm.
idiomatic: On the xinyou day a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

literal: Day renxu: General of Chariots and Cavalry, Equipage Equal to the Three Directors, Wang Su died.
idiomatic: On the renxu day Wang Su, general of chariots and cavalry with equipage equal to the Three Directors, died.

literal: Ninth month, day dingyou: fifty thousand men within the capital districts were levied to build three hundred twenty-three wards of the capital [4]—the work ceased after forty days.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the dingyou day, fifty thousand men within the capital districts were levied to build three hundred twenty-three wards of the capital [4]; the work ceased after forty days.

literal: Day jihai: the empress of the Yu clan was installed.
idiomatic: On the jihai day the empress of the Yu clan was installed.

literal: Day yimao: garrison households of Shouchun were released and made people of Yangzhou.
idiomatic: On the yimao day garrison households of Shouchun were released and made people of Yangzhou.

literal: Tenth month of winter, day dingmao: Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the dingmao day, Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Day xinwei: Defending Commander of Lingling Garrison under Bao Juan, Hua Hou, led his households inward in submission.
idiomatic: On the xinwei day Hua Hou, defending commander of Lingling garrison under Bao Juan, led his households inward in submission.

literal: Eleventh month, day bingshen: General of Agile Cavalry Mu Liang was made Minister of Works.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the bingshen day, Mu Liang, general of agile cavalry, was made minister of works.

literal: Day dingyou: Grand General, Prince of Beihai Xiang was made Grand Tutor and held additionally the post of Minister over the Masses.
idiomatic: On the dingyou day Xiang, grand general and Prince of Beihai, was made grand tutor and held additionally the post of minister over the masses.

literal: Day renyin: the Circular Mound Altar was rebuilt on the south bank of the Yi River.
idiomatic: On the renyin day the Circular Mound Altar was rebuilt on the south bank of the Yi River.

literal: Day yimao: sacrifice was again performed there.
idiomatic: On the yimao day sacrifice was again performed there.

literal: Twelfth month: Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

literal: That month Bao Juan's personal attendant Zhang Qi killed his lord Bao Juan and surrendered to Xiao Yan; Yan took Jiankang.
idiomatic: That month Bao Juan's personal attendant Zhang Qi killed his lord Bao Juan and surrendered to Xiao Yan; Yan took Jiankang.

literal: Third year, second month of spring, day wuyin: an edict said: "Since Biyang the drought has lasted long; farmers have abandoned cultivation; upon reflection shame increases—much rests on us.
idiomatic: In the third year, in the second month of spring, on the wuyin day, an edict said, "Since Biyang the drought has lasted long; farmers have abandoned cultivation; upon reflection shame increases—much rests on us.

literal: Send down to provinces and commanderies: wherever bones lie exposed, all may be buried.
idiomatic: Send down to provinces and commanderies: wherever bones lie exposed, all may be buried.

literal: " Third month: the Luoyang barbarians rebelled.
idiomatic: " In the third month the Luoyang barbarians rebelled.

literal: Bao Juan's younger brother, Prince of Jian'an Bao Zhao, came to surrender.
idiomatic: Bao Juan's younger brother, Bao Zhao, Prince of Jian'an, came to surrender.

literal: Seventh month of autumn, day guiyou: Khotan sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the guiyou day, Khotan sent envoys with tribute.

literal: An edict advanced civil officials who had followed campaigns with distinction or served in the inner guard two ranks, and those in idle posts one rank.
idiomatic: An edict advanced civil officials who had followed campaigns with distinction or served in the inner guard two ranks, and those in idle posts one rank.

literal: Eighth month, day guimao: Bao Rong's General Who Guards the South and Inspector of Yangzhou Chen Bozhi sent envoys requesting surrender.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the guimao day, Chen Bozhi, Bao Rong's general who guards the south and inspector of Yangzhou, sent envoys requesting surrender.

literal: Day yimao: the former Grand Tutor, Duke of Pingyang Pi, was made one of the Three Elders.
idiomatic: On the yimao day Pi, the former grand tutor and Duke of Pingyang, was made one of the Three Elders.

literal: Ninth month, day dingsi: the imperial carriage traveled to Ye.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the dingsi day, the imperial carriage traveled to Ye.

literal: Day dingmao: an edict ordered envoys to offer condolences at the tomb of Yin Bi Gan.
idiomatic: On the dingmao day an edict ordered envoys to offer condolences at the tomb of Yin Bi Gan.

literal: Day wuyin: military review south of Ye.
idiomatic: On the wuyin day a military review was held south of Ye.

literal: Day gengchen: the heir of Wuxing, Yang Shaoxian, sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the gengchen day Yang Shaoxian, heir of Wuxing, sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Tenth month of winter, day gengzi: the emperor shot in person, the distance reaching one li and fifty paces; the assembled ministers had an inscription cut at the archery ground.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the gengzi day, the emperor shot in person, the distance reaching one li and fifty paces; the assembled ministers had an inscription cut at the archery ground.

literal: Day jiachen: the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
idiomatic: On the jiachen day the imperial carriage returned to the palace.

literal: Eleventh month, day jimao: an edict said: "Luoyang has lain in military ruin, years exceeding ten reign-periods.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the jimao day, an edict said, "Luoyang has lain in military ruin, years exceeding ten reign-periods.

literal: The late emperor fixed the tripod at the old capital and renewed the Wei calendar; he cleared away thorns and wilderness and founded these cloud-structures—great merit and abundant achievement, planning far ahead.
idiomatic: The late emperor fixed the tripod at the old capital and renewed the Wei calendar; he cleared away thorns and wilderness and founded these cloud-structures—great merit and abundant achievement, planning far ahead.

literal: Now the altars of soil and grain are established and the palace pole rises high; we should in the middle of this coming month choose an auspicious day to move the court.
idiomatic: Now the altars of soil and grain are established and the palace pole rises high; we should in the middle of this coming month choose an auspicious day to move the court.

literal: Looking up we seek the testamentary intent; joy and emotion meet in the breast.
idiomatic: Looking up we seek the testamentary intent; joy and emotion meet in the breast.

literal: This is ritual as grand as King Xuan of Zhou's "Dry Bank," and ceremony as high as Han Founder's splendid rites; according to precedent one may complete the solemn announcement, to answer the hope of subjects near and far.
idiomatic: This is ritual as grand as King Xuan of Zhou's "Dry Bank," and ceremony as high as Han Founder's splendid rites; according to precedent one may complete the solemn announcement, to answer the hope of subjects near and far.

literal: " Twelfth month, day wuzi: an edict said: "The people root in farming and sericulture; the state weighs mulberry registers; the vessels of grain depend on them; the court robes rest on them.
idiomatic: " In the twelfth month, on the wuzi day, an edict said, "The people root in farming and sericulture; the state weighs mulberry registers; the vessels of grain depend on them; the court robes rest on them.

literal: When the capital was first founded, farming and sericulture were for a time lacking; the departed regulations and former aims ought surely to be reverently maintained.
idiomatic: When the capital was first founded, farming and sericulture were for a time lacking; the departed regulations and former aims ought surely to be reverently maintained.

literal: Now the residence halls are manifestly complete and the move of the court is just beginning; the spring suburban sacrifice is not far off; the day to brush the plow has its season.
idiomatic: Now the residence halls are manifestly complete and the move of the court is just beginning; the spring suburban sacrifice is not far off; the day to brush the plow has its season.

literal: We may memorialize to establish the thousand-acre field and open the palace altar; holding the plow and carrying the basket, we shall personally urge the hundred million.
idiomatic: We may memorialize to establish the thousand-acre field and open the palace altar; holding the plow and carrying the basket, we shall personally urge the hundred million.

literal: " Day renyin: the assembled ministers were feasted at the Hall before the Grand Ultimate; cloth and silk were given in grades, because the work was newly finished.
idiomatic: " On the renyin day the assembled ministers were feasted at the Hall before the Grand Ultimate; cloth and silk were given in grades, because the work was newly finished.

literal: Day jiachen: Yangzhou defeated Xiao Yan's general Zhang Xizhi and took more than two thousand heads.
idiomatic: On the jiachen day Yangzhou defeated Xiao Yan's general Zhang Xizhi and took more than two thousand heads.

literal: That year Shule, Jibin, Boluona, Wuchang, Ayutuo, Luopo, Bulun, Tuobaluo, Fubonüti, Siluo, Dashe, Fuqixinatai, Luopan, Wuji, Xiwangjin, Zhujupan, Hepantu, Bojin, Yanmei, Zhuzhenluo, South Tianzhu, Chishanasi, and other states all sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: That year Shule, Jibin, Boluona, Wuchang, Ayutuo, Luopo, Bulun, Tuobaluo, Fubonüti, Siluo, Dashe, Fuqixinatai, Luopan, Wuji, Xiwangjin, Zhujupan, Hepantu, Bojin, Yanmei, Zhuzhenluo, South Tianzhu, Chishanasi, and other states all sent envoys with tribute.

literal: [5] Hezhou suffered great famine; more than two thousand died.
idiomatic: [5] Hezhou suffered great famine; more than two thousand died.

literal: Fourth year, spring, first month, day yihai: the imperial carriage performed the plowing ceremony at the thousand-acre field.
idiomatic: In the fourth year, in the first month of spring, on the yihai day, the imperial carriage performed the plowing ceremony at the thousand-acre field.

literal: The Di of Liangzhou, Yang Hui, rebelled.
idiomatic: The Di of Liangzhou, Yang Hui, rebelled.

literal: An edict ordered Yang Chun, acting for Liangzhou affairs, and General of the Left Yang Zhi to punish them.
idiomatic: An edict ordered Yang Chun, acting for Liangzhou affairs, and Yang Zhi, general of the left, to punish them.
